name: interview-me
description: Interview mode started with /interview-me <requirement or design>: one open question per message, each preceded by a brief (facts, term definitions, trade-offs at equal depth), no recommendations, no assumed defaults, no multiple-choice menus; contradictions between answers (and with existing docs/adr records) are resolved; ends when the user approves the clarified requirement or design, then offers architecture decision records and files only the ones the user picks via the adrs CLI.
